Constant Hessian admits arbitrarily small positive Lipschitz constant. Derive A=Δf+Δτ D/8, with trapezoid remainder O(L Δτ³||g||³); correcting a sign typo in the package intermediate display, the identity is Δτ D/8 + (1/2)(g+g_new)^T(x_new-x)=Δτ||g_new-g||²/8, since x_new-x=-Δτ g. The gradient-difference norm is at most B Δτ||g|| and leads to A<=(ξL/2+B²/8) Δτ³||g||², giving K0>=2/sqrt(12ξL+3B²) whenever K0 is real/nonzero gradient. On f=λx²/2, z=λΔτ, direct K0=√[(z-2)²+4]/(λ√3), minimized at z=2; independent symbolic and exact rational checks verified the main inequality, witness and sharpness. The displayed sign typo is not a defect in the final claimed inequality but merits correction.
